name: Kenai Fjords National Park
policyReason: Pets are allowed in only a few select areas and are prohibited on trails at all times.
summary: Pets are allowed in only a few select areas and are prohibited on trails at all times.

excerpts.quote: For the safety of all, pets are allowed in only a few select areas, and may not be left unattended.

dogRules.text: No pets on trails past the Exit Glacier parking lot.
No pets along the coast to 1/4 mile inland, May 30 to Nov 1.
Mushing and skijoring dogs allowed on the Harding Icefield.
